text:
Ayesha (product): Quick sync - planning an enterprise regulatory pilot for Acme Bank. Key asks from them: tenant-level retention lanes, immutable audit exports with chain-of-custody, BYOK/KMS handshake + thumbprint audit, and SOC2 evidence packaging. Can we scope an MVP for Q3?
Liam (eng-runtime): Sounds doable if we limit day 1 scope. Need clarity on retention tiers (hot/warm/cold), whether legal-hold blocks all deletions, and if exports must be synchronous. Those affect ingestion and archival.
Gina (security): Requirements from compliance: tamper-evident export (merkle proofs + KMS-signed manifest), documented key rotation/attestation for BYOK, and retention >2yrs = privacy review.
Marcus (ops): Cost reality check: hot for 90d vs long-term cold for 7y changes storage ops and restore SLAs. Suggest default lanes: 90d hot, 2y warm (infrequent access), 7y cold (glacier). Need S3 lifecycle + restore runbooks.
Rana (legal): Also need EU data residency toggle for this tenant and export format that includes approver id, legal_hold flag, and policy version. Export must be admissible for e-discovery.
Jules (customer-success): For the pilot we should provide: onboarding checklist, sample export package, and a customer-facing SLA doc. Acme wants an async export they can validate.
Liam (eng-runtime): Proposed minimal tenant config (example):
```json
{ "tenant_id": "acme-bank", "retention": { "default_days": "90", "overrides": [ {"name": "warm","days": "730"}, {"name": "cold","days": "2555"} ], "legal_hold": "false" }, "residency": "eu" }
```
Liam (eng-runtime): Implementation notes: ingestion -> hot topic with prefix/KV cache; periodic archival job writes checkpointed cold objects and records merkle roots. Need tickets: (1) legal-hold immutability flag in storage layer, (2) export manifest generator with KMS signature.
Gina (security): Security acceptance criteria: manifest includes merkle root, timestamp, KMS key thumbprint, and signature. BYOK handshake must log key thumbprint + consent record. Exports must be integrity-verified.
Rana (legal): Confirmed. Add that export manifest must include chain-of-custody metadata (who requested, who approved, jurisdiction, retention policy id).
Marcus (ops): I'll prep cost estimates per lane for pilot (per TB/month for hot/warm/cold) and a short restore-time runbook for SLA commitments.
Ayesha (product): Draft launch checklist: 
- MVP supports per-tenant retention up to 7y (overrides)
- Legal-hold prevents deletion and is surfaced via Console + API
- Async export within 24h producing gzipped bundle + manifest + merkle proof + KMS sigs
- BYOK handshake + thumbprint audit recorded
- SOC2 mapping updated to reflect immutable streams and export artifacts
- Pilot onboarding doc + cost estimates for Acme
Liam (eng-runtime): Timeline: spike this sprint, infra + hooks in next 2 sprints if we punt multi-region replication to later.
Gina (security): I'll own security acceptance; want design review by Wed.
Jules (customer-success): I will draft onboarding & sample exports; need product copy by Fri to share with Acme.
Rana (legal): I'll review export fields and check jurisdictional constraints. Also: clarify if export is on-demand or scheduled.
deploy-bot: <deploy-bot> ACLs passed for infra spike branch (CI #1423) :white_check_mark:
Ayesha (product): Next actions: Liam to open infra + API tickets, Gina & Rana to finalize acceptance fields, Marcus to add cost/runbook, Jules to prepare onboarding/sample export. Sync tomorrow 11:00.
Liam (eng-runtime): Filed tickets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/2234 (archival lifecycle), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/7890 (legal-hold API).
Marcus (ops): Cost ticket opened and I'll attach restore-time numbers.
Gina (security): Note: retention >2 years requires DPO sign-off for GDPR — I'll coordinate.
Rana (legal): Acme prefers async export with verifiable artifacts; aim for <=24h for MVP.
Ayesha (product): Great. If we lock acceptance by EOD tomorrow we can include pilot in Q3 release plan. Meeting invite sent for 11am. Thanks all :thumbsup:
